d:
Some melodies capture the magic of love like no other! Enjoy “Kehti Hai Dil Ki Lagi,” a beautiful romantic song featuring Shah Rukh Khan and Juhi Chawla from the film Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman (1992). Sung by the ever-popular Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, this melodious duet brings together the charm of 90s Bollywood romance.
Kehti Hai Dil Ki Lagi | Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman(1992) | Shahrukh Khan, Juhi Chawla | Kumar-Alka Hits
Song: Kehti Hai Dil Ki Lagi
Movie: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman (1992)
Star Cast: Shahrukh Khan, Juhi Chawla
Singers: Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik
Music Director: Jatin Lalit
